name: Zoku Portopia Renzoku Satsujin Jiken: Boukyaku no Maisou
original_name: 続ポートピア連続殺人事件:忘却の埋葬
source:
Supervised by executive director Yuji Horii, five new investigation files told from shifting perspectives have been added to The Portopia Serial Murder Case!

Set in 1980s Kobe, players can enjoy a completely new detective experience—investigating alongside a new cast of characters to uncover the secrets hidden behind the original murders.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2026/09/next-the-portopia-serial-murder-case-announced-for-switch-2-switch-and-pc]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
由执行总监堀井雄二亲自监修，《港口镇连续杀人事件》正式追加五份以多重视角展开的全新搜查档案！

以1980年代的神户为舞台，玩家将体验焕然一新的刑侦推理乐趣——与全新登场的角色阵容并肩搜查，揭开当年连环凶案背后尘封的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2026/09/next-the-portopia-serial-murder-case-announced-for-switch-2-switch-and-pc]Gematsu[/url]]
